name: Ling-3.0-flash-VL

lineage.how_derived: adds a ViT encoder, a two-layer MLP projector and VideoRoPE for native image and video understanding

purpose: Next-generation native multimodal model that brings visual information into understanding, reasoning, acting and verification: object counting, layouts, charts, documents, web and software interfaces translated into action sequences (card).

license.name: MIT (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag mit; the repo has no LICENSE file in its listing.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear attention MoE vision-language: 42-layer backbone alternating KDA and Gated MLA at 5:1, ViT encoder, VideoRoPE
architecture.attention: Kimi Delta Attention to gated MLA 5:1
architecture.why_this_design: card: the 5:1 KDA/MLA hybrid enables efficient long-context processing across text, images, videos and long agent histories; the sparse MoE keeps 124B capacity at 5.5B active per token

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.1.1
benchmarks.variant: BF16; Ling-3.0-flash 38; card says Terminal-Bench 2.1 uses the AA protocol (Terminus 2, 2 h timeout, 3 runs)

strengths: +4 points on the AA index over its text-only base from adding vision (vendor)
GUI and web interface understanding named as a target
weaknesses: no numeric multimodal benchmark table was readable in the card text (tables are images)
